lines.en: I walk heavily on four legs.
The vines on my back sway.
I flatten a patch of low grass.
My teeth are large.
I keep to the forest edge.
Each step kicks up earth.
My vines scrape the bark.
I swing my head as I walk.

lines.zh: 我比周围的树还高一点
lines.en: I stand a little taller than the trees.
I circle around a thicket.

lines.zh: 我站在树旁，像另一棵树
lines.en: I stand by a tree like another tree.
The vines on my back keep growing.
I chew a large leaf.
The birds here do not fear me.
I lower my head to rest.
I nudge the soil with my snout.
My teeth are not suited to meat.

lines.zh: 我嚼着叶子，等日头升高
lines.en: I chew leaves and wait for the sun to climb
My tail sweeps a patch of grass.
The vines on me are longer than yesterday.
I rub my jaw against a tree.
Juice fills my mouth as I chew.
Leaves are shaking in the distance.

lines.zh: 我把长脖子弯下来看你
lines.en: I bend my long neck down at you.
You stand inside my shadow.
I do not much like noise.
You may touch my vines, not pull.
My teeth only look fierce.
Where are you off to?
You smell of leaves.

lines.zh: 我慢慢往旁边挪了一步
lines.en: I shift one step aside.

lines.zh: 你走在前面，藤条扫着你
lines.en: You walk ahead while my vines brush you
I know this forest well.
You may sit beside me.

lines.zh: 森林里，我的耳朵动了动。
lines.en: In the forest, my ears twitch.
Stand still; I will not chase.
I give a muffled roar and step back.
That hit my leg.
A few vines have snapped.
I rock, and still hold.

lines.zh: 我脖子一偏，撞断了树枝
lines.en: My neck swings aside and snaps a branch
I can still stand steady.
Blood falls on the soil.
I need a moment.
Those leaves look good.
That branch you hold is too thin.
I prefer buds from the trees.
This tastes fresh.
Enough for a short while.
One branch is not enough.

lines.zh: 你手里的嫩叶，味道不错吧？
lines.en: Those tender leaves in your hand — tasty, right?
Share a little and I'll follow you.
I am barely moved.
You hit a solid leg.
I stop to let you by.
That shoved me off line.
Our feet churn the soil.
I walk slowly past you.
My vines brush your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你太小了，我差点没看到
lines.en: You are so small I nearly missed you.
I step back and crush the grass.
There are not many of us in this forest.

lines.zh: 我的藤条可以给她遮阴
lines.en: My vines can give her shade.
We eat leaves together.
This body of mine is unwieldy.
As long as she does not mind me.
We hold this patch of forest.
I do not take; I wait here.
Just being quiet together is enough.
I will go graze over there.
I lower my head and take it.
My crest can sound a note.

lines.zh: 我嘴太大，抓不住小东西
lines.en: My mouth is too big for small things.
Can I carry this on my back?
It rolled to the tree roots.
I lower my head to sniff, then lift it
I move on and leave it.
I'll take this — don't be stingy.
Do not stand too close.
I am going that way.
There is no room to pass.
One stride of mine is long.
My long neck lowers to look at you
The trees are too thick for you to back out
The vines on me will catch on things.
We need only wait.
I am slow; you need not rush.
Push me and I may fall.
This side is wider.
I go round the other side.
I keep just behind you.

lines.zh: 花森林里，我头上的花比草高。
lines.en: In the flower forest my blossom stands above grass.
You walk too fast.
The soil under me is soft.
I am looking for a place to stand.
The trees are too thick to pass.
This is best for everyone.
I will go around it.
I know this place very well.
I swing my head into you.
That was by accident.
My foot landed beside you.
A vine whips across you.
I am forced back.
That was not very heavy.
I have stopped again.
Just get further off.
Let us not do this.

lines.zh: 我甩藤的时候没看方向
lines.en: I lashed the vine without aiming.
My vine lashes out and I pull the blow
I step out from behind the old tree
The vines on my back are still new.
I have been in this forest before.
First I sniffed the forest.
The sun falls well on the trunks.
I shake the vines on my back.
Birds take flight in the distance.
I walk slowly into the clearing.
My footsteps are heavy.
I can stay here a while.
Leaves still hang from my vines.
Wind comes out of the trees.
Fire scorches the vines on my back.
I slide down the slope.
Water reaches my jaw.
The blast knocks me down.
A point stays in my side.
That force makes my legs heavy.
I am chewing roots with hunger.

lines.zh: 雷落在林子里，我僵住了
lines.en: Lightning strikes the forest and I freeze.
There is no soil to tread here.
